problems.reason: The page states Melanorosaurus lived from the Norian to the Sinemurian (227.3–192.9 Ma), but the Lower Elliot Formation, where its fossils were found, is Late Triassic, not extending into the Early Jurassic Sinemurian. This contradicts the geological context given in sentence 8.
